## Oracle recovery on unseen difficulty (learned seeds)

recovery = (rule acc − fixed-T=8 acc) / (oracle acc − fixed-T=8 acc), computed on seed means; 1 = as good as the oracle, 0 = no better than T=8.

| probe | 0.36 | 0.77 | 0.74 | 0.74 | 0.67 |

| stable | 0.79 | 0.62 | 0.32 | 0.05 | -0.08 |
| probe_safe | 0.62 | 0.85 | 0.84 | 0.81 | 0.75 |
| fixedpoint_safe | 0.17 | 0.01 | -0.02 | -0.01 | -0.01 |
| stable_safe | 0.95 | 0.81 | 0.56 | 0.11 | 0.00 |

## Mixed-difficulty workload (all 8 test levels equally weighted; mean over seeds)

A deployable fixed-T model must use one T for every input. `best fixed T at ≤ FLOPs` = the most accurate single T whose mean FLOPs do not exceed the rule's (chosen with test data, so it favours the fixed-T baseline).

Best single fixed T overall: T=27, 66.8% at 8.41e+07 FLOPs.
